help.usage:
Usage: guideline <command> [options]

In a project (guideline server)
  common --source <name>   a source (sources in guideline.json). For pick, an unknown name together with --server adds a new source
  pick     choose guidelines to export in a web form; submitting applies them to this project
             --project <path>    target project (default: current directory)
             --new <name|path>   create a new project (a bare name goes under GUIDELINE_PROJECTS_DIR)
             --server <URL>      guideline server (default: guideline.json → GUIDELINE_SERVER)
             --no-browser        print the address instead of opening a browser
             --json              print the result (written files, to-dos) as JSON
  update   re-apply the chosen items from the latest server revision
             --project <path>  --server <URL>
             --force             also overwrite files changed in the project
             --json              print the result as JSON
  status   show whether the applied guidelines are current and what the project changed
             --project <path>  --server <URL>  --json
  login    log in to a guideline server and store a read token
             --server <URL>
             --token-stdin       store a token from standard input instead of using a browser
  logout   delete the stored token and revoke it on the server
             --server <URL>
  propose  turn edited copies back into source form and propose them to the server (they become source when an admin accepts)
             --project <path>  --server <URL>
             --title <title>     proposal title (default: guidelines edited in <directory>)
             --message <text>    proposal description
             --only <item,…>     only these items (e.g. rules/base/01-git.md,skills/s)
             --from <folder>     compare a folder from guideline source against the revision it came from (--title required)
             --dry-run           show the changes and diffs without sending
             --apply             with an admin token, apply directly instead of proposing
             --json              print the result as JSON
  source   unpack the latest server source into an empty folder; edit it in source layout, then propose --from
             guideline source <folder>  --server <URL>
  list     list the source and its checks. With a folder, read that folder (a source from guideline source); otherwise the server
             guideline list [folder]  --server <URL>  --json
  locale   language packs: check <folder> compares a pack with English; list shows available languages. The language is GUIDELINE_LANG
             guideline locale check <folder>  guideline locale list  --json
  help     this help
